summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The npm preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh GitHub releases into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled math_init.js payload shipped at the tarball root. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle using rotated string-array obfuscation with no readable source; setup.mjs itself is minified with obfuscator.io-style `_0x`-prefixed identifiers and lookup-object string indirection to hide the download URL, filenames, and exec calls. package.json declares `"files": ["lib/*"]`, but setup.mjs and math_init.js are both shipped at the tarball root, outside the author's declared publish surface. On `npm install`, this pattern executes an opaque payload of unknown behavior under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime that bypasses Node-based inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
